# TokenRecovered

`schemas/records/token-recovered.json`

The payload of identity.token_recovered/v1, offline operator-credential recovery (docs/design/m0/14 R7). The system actor issues a new token to an existing live operator, outside the one-time bootstrap issuance; the event's subject is the new token. It carries the token's record (its hash, never the secret) and the ids of that operator's other live tokens it revokes in the same transition, at the new token's created_at. It never creates, revokes or restores an actor and never changes the bootstrap state.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | yes | [token](records-token.md) |  |
| `revoke` | yes | array of [TokenID](common-defs.md#tokenid) (unique items) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
